decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	Due to the positioning, design and size, the single storey side and rear extension, and first floor side extension, and roof extension will result in a bulky development that detrimentally affects the appearance of the dwellinghouse and the character of the street scene. The proposal is therefore inconsistent with the provisions of ENV B.1.1 - New Development, H.6.4 - Extensions and Alterations and fails to preserve and or enhance the Spring Grove Conservation Area contrary to  ENV B2.2 - Conservation Areas.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed rear first floor balcony is of a size that can be used at a great intensity. The balcony therefore has the potential to harm the visual and acoustic privacy of the neighbouring residents and is contrary to the provisions of Policies ENV B.1.1 - New Development and  H.6.4 of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension single storey rear and side extensions and roof lights to front elevation of existing dwellinghouse.
